title.purpose: Names Demux in the identity header.

heading.purpose: Labels the queue, output settings, and progress surfaces.

body.purpose: Carries file names, controls, guidance, and status copy.

label.purpose: Supports compact field labels and secondary metadata.

shadows.name: panel-ambient
shadows.purpose: Separate major panels from the near-black workspace without decorative glow.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Starts extraction or adds the first set of media files.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: rgb(0.43, 0.36, 0.96); color: rgb(0.92, 0.93, 0.96); padding: 13px 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(0.43, 0.36, 0.96); border-radius: 12px; font: 600 14px system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease, color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgb(0.50, 0.43, 1); border-color: rgb(0.54, 0.47, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(0.59, 0.54, 0.98); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: rgb(0.36, 0.29, 0.82); border-color: rgb(0.40, 0.33, 0.90); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: rgb(0.16, 0.15, 0.28); border-color: rgb(0.20, 0.19, 0.34); color: rgb(0.48, 0.50, 0.57); }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Keeps folder selection and browsing available without competing with extraction.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: rgb(0.105, 0.112, 0.135); color: rgb(0.94, 0.95, 0.98); padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(0.24, 0.25, 0.30); border-radius: 12px; font: 500 14px system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease, color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgb(0.14, 0.15, 0.18); border-color: rgb(0.32, 0.33, 0.39); color: white; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(0.59, 0.54, 0.98); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: rgb(0.065, 0.07, 0.087); border-color: rgb(0.28, 0.29, 0.35); } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { background: rgb(0.075, 0.08, 0.095); border-color: rgb(0.15, 0.16, 0.19); color: rgb(0.48, 0.50, 0.57); }

components.name: Destructive Action
components.description: Removes the selected queue item and is quiet until a selection can be removed.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: rgb(0.11, 0.085, 0.10); color: rgb(0.95, 0.76, 0.77); padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(0.36, 0.17, 0.20); border-radius: 12px; font: 500 14px system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease, color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-danger svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: rgb(0.18, 0.08, 0.095); border-color: rgb(0.60, 0.24, 0.27); color: rgb(1, 0.83, 0.84); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(0.94, 0.39, 0.42); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:active { background: rgb(0.22, 0.075, 0.09); border-color: rgb(0.94, 0.39, 0.42); color: white; } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { background: rgb(0.075, 0.08, 0.095); border-color: rgb(0.15, 0.16, 0.19); color: rgb(0.48, 0.50, 0.57); }

components.name: Path Field
components.description: Shows the chosen output folder beside a native Browse action and keeps folder-preservation policy visible for folder imports.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: rgb(0.62, 0.64, 0.70); font: 400 13px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; background: rgb(0.065, 0.07, 0.087); color: rgb(0.92, 0.93, 0.96); padding: 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(0.19, 0.20, 0.24); border-radius: 12px; font: 400 14px system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color .15s ease, background-color .15s ease; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: rgb(0.62, 0.64, 0.70); } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: rgb(0.30, 0.27, 0.55); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(0.43, 0.36, 0.96); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: rgb(0.43, 0.36, 0.96); } .ds-field input:disabled { color: rgb(0.48, 0.50, 0.57); background: rgb(0.075, 0.08, 0.095); }

components.name: Surface Panel
components.description: Frames a work surface with calm tonal separation and one ambient shadow.
components.html:
Output Settings

MP3 extraction defaults and destination.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: rgb(0.085, 0.092, 0.112); color: rgb(0.92, 0.93, 0.96); padding: 18px; border: 1px solid rgb(0.17, 0.18, 0.22); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 5px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, .22); } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 600 18px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: rgb(0.62, 0.64, 0.70); font: 400 14px system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Drop Zone
components.description: Invites file selection and communicates hover state without adding ornamental chrome.
components.html: Add videos or drop a folder to beginSupports MP4, MKV, MOV, AVI, WMV, FLV, MPEG, and more
components.css: .ds-drop-zone { display: grid; place-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 150px; padding: 20px; background: rgb(0.065, 0.07, 0.087); color: rgb(0.92, 0.93, 0.96); border: 1px dashed rgb(0.31, 0.32, 0.38); border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; transition: border-color .15s ease, background-color .15s ease; } .ds-drop-zone svg { width: 42px; height: 42px; fill: none; stroke: rgb(0.48, 0.50, 0.57); stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-drop-zone strong { font: 600 17px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-drop-zone span { color: rgb(0.62, 0.64, 0.70); font: 400 13px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-drop-zone:hover, .ds-drop-zone[data-active='true'] { border-color: rgb(0.43, 0.36, 0.96); background: rgb(0.075, 0.08, 0.10); } .ds-drop-zone:focus-within { outline: 2px solid rgb(0.43, 0.36, 0.96); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Queue Row
components.description: Keeps file identity, duration, state, output settings, source size, and two-pass normalization state comparable at a glance.
components.css: .ds-queue-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 34px minmax(180px, 7fr) 2fr 3fr 3fr 2fr; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 12px; color: rgb(0.92, 0.93, 0.96); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(0.17, 0.18, 0.22); font: 400 12px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-queue-row strong { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font: 500 13px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-queue-index, .ds-queue-status { color: rgb(0.62, 0.64, 0.70); } .ds-queue-row:hover, .ds-queue-row[data-selected='true'] { background: rgb(0.105, 0.10, 0.16); } .ds-queue-row[data-selected='true'] { box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 rgb(0.43, 0.36, 0.96); }

components.name: Outcome Toast
components.description: Provides non-blocking success or failure feedback while preserving the persistent queue state.
components.html: Extraction completedExample Video.mp3 is ready.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 7px 12px; width: min(360px, 100%); padding: 14px; border-radius: 12px; font: 400 13px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-toast strong { font: 600 15px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-toast span { color: rgb(0.92, 0.93, 0.96); } .ds-toast button { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / span 2; align-self: center; background: transparent; color: inherit; padding: 4px 6px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 7px; font: 500 12px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-toast button:hover, .ds-toast button:focus-visible { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08); } .ds-toast-success { background: rgb(0.075, 0.12, 0.10); color: rgb(0.35, 0.78, 0.57); border: 1px solid rgb(0.18, 0.42, 0.30); } .ds-toast-danger { background: rgb(0.16, 0.075, 0.085); color: rgb(0.94, 0.39, 0.42); border: 1px solid rgb(0.38, 0.14, 0.16); }

components.name: FFmpeg Log Surface
components.description: Shows bounded, job-associated FFmpeg diagnostics with tail-follow, clear, and native export actions.
components.html:
FFmpeg Log

[12:34:10] [job 1] Input #0, mov,mp4…
components.css: .ds-log { display: grid; gap: 10px; min-height: 170px; padding: 14px 16px; background: rgb(0.085, 0.092, 0.112); color: rgb(0.92, 0.93, 0.96); border: 1px solid rgb(0.17, 0.18, 0.22); border-radius: 14px; } .ds-log pre { min-height: 120px; margin: 0; overflow: auto; padding: 12px; background: rgb(0.065, 0.07, 0.087); border: 1px solid rgb(0.19, 0.20, 0.24); border-radius: 12px; font: 400 12px ui-monospace, monospace; line-height: 1.45; }

narrative.overview: Demux is a compact native work surface where media state stays legible while external tools run. Its character comes from calm dark layering, precise status language, and one restrained violet action signal—not ornamental chrome. Familiar desktop controls keep attention on the file, destination, encoding choices, loudness phase, and outcome.
keyCharacteristics: Dense enough for operational work, with generous separation between tasks.
Violet is reserved for primary action and active work.
State is always expressed with words as well as color.
Advanced controls appear only when the engine supports them honestly.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Violet belongs to the primary action or current work, not passive decoration.

dos: Keep task state visible in plain language.
Reserve the largest area for the queue and current media information.
Disable controls while their changes could race an active process.
Use native dialogs for local file and directory selection.
donts: Don't turn the log surface into a terminal emulator or expose unbounded process output.
Don't use violet for inactive decoration.
Don't render missing metadata as zero.
Don't introduce nested cards or decorative icon tiles.
